text: Baseline movement screen from photos (2026-11-16, provisional): knee-to-wall roughly 12-15 cm (5-6 in) toe-to-wall both feet, no obvious asymmetry (estimated from shoe size, not taped). Back-to-wall overhead reach: thumbs reached the wall but feet ~1 ft out with a lean, so easier than standard; repeat with heels ~15 cm out, upright, low back visible. ASLR: raised leg ~70-80 deg both sides, but the down leg was bent and lifted (overstates the result); repeat with the down leg straight on the floor. Hip rotation photos pending.
